sources.title: IFA 2026 — visitBerlin
sources.claim: IFA 2026 runs 4–8 September at Messe Berlin (Funkturm); 2025 baseline was ~220k visitors from 140 countries, ~1,900 exhibitors, ~190k m² floor.

sources.title: re:publica 26
sources.claim: re:publica 26 runs 18–20 May 2026 at STATION Berlin (Kreuzberg) with 1,000+ speakers across 20+ stages, focused on digital society.

sources.title: WeAreDevelopers World Congress
sources.claim: WeAreDevelopers World Congress runs 8–10 July 2026 at Messe Berlin South Entrance + CityCube; expected 15k+ builders, 500+ speakers, 40k m² expo.

sources.title: Bosch ConnectedWorld 2026
sources.claim: Bosch ConnectedWorld 2026 runs 10–11 June across Tempodrom + Arena Berlin; focus on AI, digital systems, mobility.

sources.title: Tech Open Air (TOA)
sources.claim: Tech Open Air (TOA) 2026 runs 2–5 June with a festival format spanning AI, climate tech, Web3, health tech.

sources.title: Berlin Design Week 2026 — visitBerlin
sources.claim: Berlin Design Week runs 28–31 May 2026 under theme DESIGN REAL with 100+ participants, 90+ locations, 15k+ visitors.

sources.title: Top tech and startup events in Berlin 2026 — techinberlin
sources.claim: Applied AI Conference Berlin runs 28 May 2026; Deep Tech Momentum runs 20–21 May.

sources.title: GITEX Europe 2026
sources.claim: GITEX AI Europe 2026 runs 30 June–1 July at Messe Berlin (2nd Berlin edition), with 2,500+ exhibitors, 1,500 startups, 500+ speakers.

sources.title: DMEA 2026
sources.claim: DMEA 2026 (Europe's leading digital-health fair) runs 21–23 April at Messe Berlin; 600 exhibitors, 350 speakers, 11k+ trade visitors.

sources.title: Rise of AI Conference 2026
sources.claim: Rise of AI Conference 2026 runs 5–6 May at Humboldt Carré Berlin (10th anniversary); ~300 in-person seats + free virtual access.

sources.title: Berlin Buzzwords 2026
sources.claim: Berlin Buzzwords 2026 runs 7–9 June at Kulturbrauerei; Europe's leading conference for open-source data infrastructure, search, and machine learning.

sources.title: GopherCon Europe 2026
sources.claim: GopherCon Europe 2026 runs 15–18 June at Festsaal Kreuzberg; 15–16 talks, 17 workshops, 18 HeyAI Summit + Community Day.

sources.title: DevOpsCon Berlin 2026
sources.claim: DevOpsCon Berlin 2026 runs 15–19 June at Maritim proArte; DevOps / SRE / cloud-native focus.

sources.title: IT Security Summit Berlin
sources.claim: IT Security Summit Berlin runs 15–19 June 2026 at Maritim proArte; hands-on cloud / DevSecOps / web / API / AI security.

sources.title: Greentech Festival Berlin
sources.claim: Greentech Festival Berlin 2026 runs 23–25 June at Messe Berlin; climate tech, sustainability, green awards.

sources.title: droidcon Berlin — 10times
sources.claim: droidcon Berlin 2026 runs 7–9 October at CityCube Berlin; the city's primary Android / mobile development conference.

sources.title: Smart Country Convention 2026
sources.claim: Smart Country Convention 2026 runs 13–15 October at Messe Berlin; GovTech and public-sector digital transformation.

sources.title: Berlin.de trade-fair calendar
sources.claim: Berlin.de official trade-fair calendar lists Quantum Summit Berlin 22–23 September 2026 alongside other tech fairs.

sources.title: Tech in Berlin Meetup
sources.claim: Tech in Berlin Meetup has 10k+ members and hosts cross-disciplinary events on AI, Web3, startups, product, data, and software engineering.

sources.title: Disruption Network Lab
sources.claim: Disruption Network Lab runs interdisciplinary conferences and community meetups; next conference EXPOSING CRIMES IS NOT A CRIME runs 19–22 March 2026.
